summary: The traffic engineer lays the crash map over the paving list at {place}.
realLife: Oakland used its map of streets with concentrated serious crashes to coordinate safety work with arterial resurfacing.
gates: The city manages the affected street and has the project facts described here.
inGame: The city highways budget records the appropriation change. needs: mapped injury corridor, resurfacing proposal and designed safety treatment.

turns.pulledBy: The city increases its street appropriation and the following records identify an eligible use: mapped injury corridor, resurfacing proposal and designed safety treatment.
turns.what: Schedule the designed safety treatment during resurfacing.

turns.pulledBy: A smaller city appropriation requires the office to revisit the commitment documented by these records: mapped injury corridor, resurfacing proposal and designed safety treatment.
turns.what: Have traffic staff identify which approved safety work has separate funding if resurfacing slips.
